title: Garmi mein Jungle ka haal 🥵😂
hook: Jungle mein garmi ka record toot gaya!
cta: Is garmi mein TUM kaun ho?
description: Garmi itni ke sher ki izzat bhi pighal gayi. Bhaalu fridge se nikalne ko tayyar nahi, aur Chill Bhai ko garmi lagti hi nahi.
pinned_comment: Main to 2 hoon, fridge se nahi nikalna 🧊

shots.first_frame: Sher lies exhausted on a sun-baked rock next to a broken air conditioner and a small blue table fan, tongue hanging out, sweat drops on his face.
shots.motion: Sher pants heavily with his tongue wagging, sweat drops roll down, he lifts his head weakly toward the fan then flops back down dramatically. Slow push-in.
shots.sound: heavy panting, fan humming, dramatic groan
shots.caption: AC bhi gaya... izzat bhi gayi

shots.first_frame: Bhaalu sits inside an open fridge in the jungle, eyes closed, licking a pink popsicle, cold mist around him.
shots.motion: Bhaalu happily licks his popsicle, sways his head side to side and hugs himself as cold mist flows out of the fridge. Gentle handheld camera.
shots.caption: Main fridge se bahar NAHI niklunga

shots.first_frame: Hathi stands in a muddy puddle holding a shower head with his trunk, laughing with eyes squeezed shut, water spraying.
shots.motion: Hathi swings his trunk spraying water everywhere, flaps his big ears and bounces, splashing in the puddle. Camera tilts up with the spray.
shots.caption: Apna shower, apni marzi

shots.first_frame: Chill Bhai stands confidently in a sunny tropical clearing, smug smile, fist raised, sunglasses on.
shots.motion: Chill Bhai does a confident little dance with hip sways and fist pumps, tail wiggling, then lowers his sunglasses and winks at the camera.
shots.sound: cool whoosh, ukulele strum, a bright ding on the wink
shots.caption: Garmi? Kaun si garmi?
